subject: Science
stem: Sound is produced by the vibration of an object and travels through a medium as a series of compressions and rarefactions. Sound travels fastest through:

options.option_text: Solids (faster than in liquids or gases)
Gases (faster than in solids or liquids)
It travels at the same speed in all media

explanation: Sound travels fastest through solids (particles closely packed, transmitting vibrations efficiently), slower through liquids, and slowest through gases — and cannot travel through a vacuum at all, since it needs a medium.
